Settings

Online leaderboard setup: create a free Supabase project and a table named scores with columns player_name (text), distance (int8), dino (text), created_at (timestamptz). Enable read/insert access with an appropriate Row Level Security policy, then paste your project URL and anon/public key in the Leaderboard tab. Never paste a service_role secret key.
